description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments. Together with our partners, customers and the world of science, we develop leading-edge technologies, and excellent products and services for about 40 markets and for thousands of applications: seals, vibration control components, batteries and fuel cells, technical textiles, filters, cleaning technologies and products, specialty chemicals and medical products.

You support our team as Procurement Professional with English

Responsibilities

  • Execute procurement strategies defined by the Commodity / Lead Buyer;
  • Create and trigger purchase orders based on SAP info records;
  • Monitor and follow up on purchase orders until goods receipt, including supplier dunning when necessary;
  • Verify and process order confirmations (quantities and delivery dates); collaborate with the Commodity Buyer for PO adjustments when pricing or conditions are incorrect;
  • Review and validate invoices, especially in case of quantity variances; escalate cost or condition discrepancies to the Commodity Buyer;
  • Ensure compliance with internal requirements, maintaining On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets and optimal stock levels;
  • Manage and track quality notifications (Q-notifications), coordinating internally with Quality Assurance and externally with suppliers;
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Production Planning and suppliers regarding delivery and quality deviations;
  • Serve as first-level contact for supplier escalations and interface with the Commodity Buyer for resolution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration, or a related field;
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in procurement, preferably in direct materials purchasing;
  • Hands-on experience with SAP (S/4HANA – MM module) or similar ERP systems;
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, supply chain flows, and supplier management;
  • Fluent in English;
  • Good knowledge of MS Office tools, especially Excel;
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities;
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines;
  • Strong communication skills for both internal stakeholders and external suppliers;
  • Proactive attitude with a focus on continuous improvement and achieving OTD (On-Time Delivery) targets.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
